frequency_question: What proportion of contested major proposed rules reach final publication within 315 days of proposal when certain precursor signals are present?
membership_rule: Includes rules categorized as economically significant that faced heavy public/legal contention and advanced past the notice-and-comment stage; excludes minor procedural updates.
coverage_note: 6 named cases representing major contested regulatory initiatives in relevant domains.
known_gaps: Excludes minor agency adjustments that lack high economic thresholds.
skeleton: Contested immigration and labor rulemaking initiatives across recent administrations with explicit cost-threshold triggers.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 6 comparable major contested regulatory pushes within the timeframe window.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to standard administrative procedure timelines and executive rulemaking behavior, which remains stable across presidential terms.
